identification: Six boxes of pale green/white alabaster-swirl art glass tableware: many square plates (large and small), round bowls, small tumblers/votive-style cups, and two shaped (folded-rim) bowls. No maker marks or stickers visible in photos. Resembles Kosta Boda Atoll (Anna Ehrner) swirl styling for the cups and round bowls, but the square plates and unmarked pieces may be a different or generic make; maker is unconfirmed.
